scenes.title: Point & Figure 3-Box Horizontal Count Target Formula

beats.hindi_tts: यह फॉर्मूला तकनीकी विश्लेषण में स्तरों और लक्ष्यों की गणना करने के लिए एक सटीक गणितीय आधार प्रदान करता है।

beats.en_narration: In a genuine hammer the lower shadow is twice the body length closing near the high, whereas a false breakdown fails to sustain closing penetration.

ui_state.question: On a timeless Point and Figure chart with a $1.00 box size and a standard 3-box reversal rule, an accumulation base spans 12 horizontal columns before generating an upside breakout above $50.00 from a base low of $42.00. What is the projected horizontal count price target?
options: A) $54.00 (adding the 12 columns directly to the base low)
B) $78.00 (calculating 12 columns multiplied by $1.00 box size times 3-box reversal added to the $42.00 base low)
C) $62.00 (adding 12 columns to the $50.00 breakout point)
D) Point and Figure charts cannot calculate price targets.

ui_state.question: On a timeless Point and Figure chart with a $1.00 box size and a standard 3-box reversal rule, an accumulation base spans 12 horizontal columns before generating an upside breakout above $50.00 from a base low of $42.00. What is the projected horizontal count price target?
options: A) $54.00 (adding the 12 columns directly to the base low)
B) $78.00 (calculating 12 columns multiplied by $1.00 box size times 3-box reversal added to the $42.00 base low)
C) $62.00 (adding 12 columns to the $50.00 breakout point)
D) Point and Figure charts cannot calculate price targets.

7. Long shadows on candlesticks reveal rejected price levels and aggressive institutional defense.
8. Combine chart types: use bar charts for structure, P&F for targets, and candlesticks for triggers.
